info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Alder Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Alder Pendant Detail Creation API facilitates the registration of detailed information about Alder Pendant products in the catalog. This endpoint allows users to provide essential attributes such as specifications, pricing, and images. Typically utilized by product managers and e-commerce platforms, this API streamlines the catalog management process, enabling businesses to enhance their product offerings and improve inventory accuracy. Through this operation, organizations can ensure that their customers have access to comprehensive product information, thereby driving informed purchasing decisions.

post.summary: Create new details for an Alder Pendant.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit new details for an Alder Pendant. It accepts a JSON body with the necessary information for the product details. Make sure to include all required attributes to ensure a successful creation.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating alder pendant details. It must contain the necessary fields as specified in the schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved details for the alder pendant.
